questions.question_text: What is a key benefit of using the Cornell Method for note-taking, as discussed in the chapter?

options.text: It focuses on drawing detailed pictures instead of writing notes
It organizes notes into sections for keywords, main ideas, and summaries, making review easier
It requires writing every word from a source without summarizing
It is only useful for digital note-taking on apps like Evernote

correct_answer.text: It organizes notes into sections for keywords, main ideas, and summaries, making review easier

questions.question_text: What is the main purpose of creating an annotated bibliography, according to the chapter?

options.text: To list sources without any additional information for quick reference
To provide a summary, evaluation, and relevance of each source used in research
To copy and paste full articles into a single document
To avoid citing sources properly in a research paper

correct_answer.text: To provide a summary, evaluation, and relevance of each source used in research

questions.question_text: How can digital tools likeZoterohelp with research organization, based on the chapter’s explanation?

options.text: They automatically write essays and reports for students
They manage sources, store citations, and auto-format bibliographies, saving time
They only work for storing unrelated personal photos and videos
They prevent students from accessing online articles and PDFs

correct_answer.text: They manage sources, store citations, and auto-format bibliographies, saving time

questions.question_text: What is a recommended strategy to avoid procrastination in research, as mentioned in the chapter?

options.text: Waiting until the last day before a deadline to start working
Breaking down tasks into smaller goals with a timeline and using techniques like Pomodoro
Spending most of the time on social media to relax before starting
Ignoring deadlines and working only when feeling motivated

correct_answer.text: Breaking down tasks into smaller goals with a timeline and using techniques like Pomodoro
